questions.guidance: The organization shall plan and prepare for managing information security incidents by defining, establishing and communicating incident management processes, roles and responsibilities.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented information security incident management planning and preparation? (Annex A.5.24)

questions.guidance: A set of policies for information security shall be defined, approved by management, published, communicated to and acknowledged by relevant personnel and relevant interested parties.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented policies for information security? (Annex A.5.1)

questions.guidance: Changes to information processing facilities and information systems shall be subject to change management procedures.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented change management? (Annex A.8.32)

questions.guidance: The organization's approach to managing information security shall be independently reviewed at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented independent review of information security? (Annex A.5.35)

questions.guidance: Information security roles and responsibilities shall be defined and allocated.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented information security roles and responsibilities? (Annex A.5.2)

questions.guidance: Management shall require all personnel to apply information security in accordance with the established policies and procedures.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented management responsibilities? (Annex A.5.4)

questions.guidance: Conflicting duties and areas of responsibility shall be segregated.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented segregation of duties? (Annex A.5.3)

questions.guidance: Appropriate contacts with relevant authorities shall be maintained.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented contact with authorities? (Annex A.5.5)

questions.guidance: Information security shall be integrated into project management.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented information security in project management? (Annex A.5.8)

questions.guidance: Audit tests and other assurance activities involving assessment of operational systems shall be planned and agreed between the tester and appropriate management.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented protection of information systems during audit testing? (Annex A.8.34)

questions.guidance: Appropriate contacts with special interest groups or other specialist security forums shall be maintained.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented contact with special interest groups? (Annex A.5.6)

questions.guidance: Information stored in information systems, devices or in any other storage media shall be deleted when no longer required.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented information deletion? (Annex A.8.10)

questions.guidance: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and other associated assets shall be established and implemented based on business and information security requirements.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented access control? (Annex A.5.15)

questions.guidance: Access rights to information and other associated assets shall be provisioned, reviewed, modified and removed in accordance with the topic-specific policy and rules.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented access rights? (Annex A.5.18)

questions.guidance: The allocation and use of privileged access rights shall be restricted and managed.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented privileged access rights? (Annex A.8.2)

questions.guidance: Protection against malware shall be implemented and supported by appropriate user awareness.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented protection against malware? (Annex A.8.7)

questions.guidance: Secure authentication technologies and procedures shall be established and implemented based on information access restrictions and the topic-specific policy on access control.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented secure authentication? (Annex A.8.5)

questions.guidance: Rules for the effective use of cryptography, including cryptographic key management, shall be defined and implemented.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented use of cryptography? (Annex A.8.24)

questions.guidance: Allocation and management of authentication information shall be controlled by a management process including advising personnel of appropriate handling.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented authentication information? (Annex A.5.17)

questions.guidance: The full life cycle of identities shall be managed.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented identity management? (Annex A.5.16)

questions.guidance: Access to information and other associated assets shall be restricted in accordance with the established topic-specific policy on access control.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented information access restriction? (Annex A.8.3)

questions.guidance: Secure areas shall be protected by appropriate entry controls and access points.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented physical entry? (Annex A.7.2)

questions.guidance: Read and write access to source code, development tools and software libraries shall be appropriately managed.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented access to source code? (Annex A.8.4)

questions.guidance: The use of utility programs that can be capable of overriding system and application controls shall be restricted and tightly controlled.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented use of privileged utility programs? (Annex A.8.18)

questions.guidance: Information security incidents shall be responded to in accordance with the documented procedures.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented response to information security incidents? (Annex A.5.26)

questions.guidance: The organization shall assess information security events and decide if they are to be categorized as information security incidents.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented assessment and decision on information security events? (Annex A.5.25)

questions.guidance: The organization shall provide a mechanism for personnel to report observed or suspected information security events through appropriate channels in a timely manner.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented information security event reporting? (Annex A.6.8)

questions.guidance: The organization shall establish and implement procedures for the identification, collection, acquisition and preservation of evidence related to information security events.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented collection of evidence? (Annex A.5.28)

questions.guidance: Knowledge gained from information security incidents shall be used to strengthen and improve the information security controls.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented learning from information security incidents? (Annex A.5.27)

questions.guidance: Information transfer rules, procedures or agreements shall be in place for all types of transfer facilities.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented information transfer? (Annex A.5.14)

questions.guidance: Personnel and relevant interested parties shall receive appropriate information security awareness, education and training and regular updates of the organization's policies and procedures.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented information security awareness, education and training? (Annex A.6.3)

questions.guidance: Information about technical vulnerabilities of information systems in use shall be obtained, the organization's exposure to such vulnerabilities shall be evaluated and appropriate measures shall be taken.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented management of technical vulnerabilities? (Annex A.8.8)

questions.guidance: Networks and network devices shall be secured, managed and controlled to protect information in systems and applications.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented networks security? (Annex A.8.20)

questions.guidance: The organization shall identify and meet requirements regarding the preservation of privacy and protection of PII as applicable.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented privacy and protection of personal information? (Annex A.5.34)

questions.guidance: Relevant information security requirements shall be established and agreed with each supplier based on the type of supplier relationship.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented addressing information security within supplier agreements? (Annex A.5.20)

questions.guidance: Information security requirements shall be identified, specified and approved when developing or acquiring applications.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented application security requirements? (Annex A.8.26)

questions.guidance: Information shall be classified according to the information security needs of the organization based on confidentiality, integrity, availability and relevant interested party requirements.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented classification of information? (Annex A.5.12)

questions.guidance: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks shall be established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented configuration management? (Annex A.8.9)

questions.guidance: Data leakage prevention measures shall be applied to systems, networks and any other devices that process, store or transmit sensitive information.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented data leakage prevention? (Annex A.8.12)

questions.guidance: ICT readiness shall be planned, implemented, maintained and tested based on business continuity objectives and ICT continuity requirements.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented ict readiness for business continuity? (Annex A.5.30)

questions.guidance: Backup copies of information, software and systems shall be maintained and regularly tested in accordance with the agreed topic-specific policy on backup.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented information backup? (Annex A.8.13)

questions.guidance: The organization shall plan how to maintain information security at an appropriate level during disruption.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented information security during disruption? (Annex A.5.29)

questions.guidance: Processes for acquisition, use, management and exit from cloud services shall be established in accordance with the organization's information security requirements.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented information security for use of cloud services? (Annex A.5.23)

questions.guidance: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented to manage the information security risks associated with the use of supplier's products or services.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented information security in supplier relationships? (Annex A.5.19)

questions.guidance: An inventory of information and other associated assets shall be identified and maintained.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented inventory of information and other associated assets? (Annex A.5.9)

questions.guidance: Legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements relevant to information security and the organization's approach to meet these requirements shall be identified, documented and kept up to date.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented legal, statutory, regulatory and contractual requirements? (Annex A.5.31)

questions.guidance: Logs that record activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events shall be produced, stored, protected and analysed.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented logging? (Annex A.8.15)

questions.guidance: Processes and procedures shall be defined and implemented for managing information security risks associated with the ICT products and services supply chain.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented managing information security in the ict supply chain? (Annex A.5.21)

questions.guidance: Networks, systems and applications shall be monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken to evaluate potential information security incidents.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented monitoring activities? (Annex A.8.16)

questions.guidance: Security perimeters shall be defined and used to protect areas that contain information and other associated assets.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented physical security perimeters? (Annex A.7.1)

questions.guidance: Records shall be protected from loss, destruction, falsification, unauthorized access and unauthorized release.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented protection of records? (Annex A.5.33)

questions.guidance: Security measures shall be implemented when personnel are working remotely to protect information accessed, processed or stored outside the organization's premises.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented remote working? (Annex A.6.7)

questions.guidance: Background verification checks on all candidates to become personnel shall be carried out prior to joining the organization and on an ongoing basis.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented screening? (Annex A.6.1)

questions.guidance: Secure coding principles shall be applied to software development.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented secure coding? (Annex A.8.28)

questions.guidance: Rules for the secure development of software and systems shall be established and applied.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented secure development life cycle? (Annex A.8.25)

questions.guidance: Items of equipment containing storage media shall be verified to ensure that any sensitive data and licensed software has been removed or securely overwritten prior to disposal or re-use.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented secure disposal or re-use of equipment? (Annex A.7.14)

questions.guidance: Principles for engineering secure systems shall be established, documented, maintained and applied to any information system development activity.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented secure system architecture and engineering principles? (Annex A.8.27)

questions.guidance: Security mechanisms, service levels and service requirements of network services shall be identified, implemented and monitored.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented security of network services? (Annex A.8.21)

questions.guidance: Security testing processes shall be defined and implemented in the development life cycle.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented security testing in development and acceptance? (Annex A.8.29)

questions.guidance: Groups of information services, users and information systems shall be segregated in the organization's networks.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented segregation of networks? (Annex A.8.22)

questions.guidance: Development, testing and production environments shall be separated and secured.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented separation of development, test and production environments? (Annex A.8.31)

questions.guidance: Storage media shall be managed through their life cycle of acquisition, use, transportation and disposal in accordance with the classification scheme and handling requirements.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented storage media? (Annex A.7.10)

questions.guidance: Employment contractual agreements shall state the personnel's and the organization's responsibilities for information security.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented terms and conditions of employment? (Annex A.6.2)

questions.guidance: Information stored on, processed by or accessible via user endpoint devices shall be protected.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented user endpoint devices? (Annex A.8.1)

questions.guidance: Rules for acceptable use and procedures for handling of information and other associated assets shall be identified, documented and implemented.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented acceptable use of information and other associated assets? (Annex A.5.10)

questions.guidance: The use of resources shall be monitored and adjusted in line with current and expected capacity requirements.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented capacity management? (Annex A.8.6)

questions.guidance: Clear desk rules for papers and removable storage media and clear screen rules for information processing facilities shall be defined and appropriately enforced.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented clear desk and clear screen? (Annex A.7.7)

questions.guidance: Compliance with the organization's information security policy, topic-specific policies, rules and standards shall be regularly reviewed.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented compliance with policies, rules and standards? (Annex A.5.36)

questions.guidance: Confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements reflecting the organization's needs for information protection shall be identified, documented, regularly reviewed and signed by personnel and relevant interested parties.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented confidentiality or non-disclosure agreements? (Annex A.6.6)

questions.guidance: Data masking shall be used in accordance with the organization's topic-specific policy on access control and other related policies and business requirements, taking applicable legislation into consideration.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented data masking? (Annex A.8.11)

questions.guidance: A disciplinary process shall be formalized and communicated to take actions against personnel who have committed an information security policy violation.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented disciplinary process? (Annex A.6.4)

questions.guidance: Operating procedures for information processing facilities shall be documented and made available to personnel who need them.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented documented operating procedures? (Annex A.5.37)

questions.guidance: Equipment shall be maintained correctly to ensure availability, integrity and confidentiality of information.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented equipment maintenance? (Annex A.7.13)

questions.guidance: Equipment shall be sited securely and protected.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented equipment siting and protection? (Annex A.7.8)

questions.guidance: Procedures and measures shall be implemented to securely manage software installation on operational systems.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented installation of software on operational systems? (Annex A.8.19)

questions.guidance: The organization shall implement appropriate procedures to protect intellectual property rights.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented intellectual property rights? (Annex A.5.32)

questions.guidance: An appropriate set of procedures for information labelling shall be developed and implemented in accordance with the classification scheme.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented labelling of information? (Annex A.5.13)

questions.guidance: The organization shall regularly monitor, review, evaluate and manage change in supplier information security practices and service delivery.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented monitoring, review and change management of supplier services? (Annex A.5.22)

questions.guidance: The organization shall direct, monitor and review the activities related to outsourced system development.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented outsourced development? (Annex A.8.30)

questions.guidance: Premises shall be continuously monitored for unauthorized physical access.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented physical security monitoring? (Annex A.7.4)

questions.guidance: Protection against physical and environmental threats shall be designed and implemented.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented protecting against physical and environmental threats? (Annex A.7.5)

questions.guidance: Information processing facilities shall be implemented with redundancy sufficient to meet availability requirements.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented redundancy of information processing facilities? (Annex A.8.14)

questions.guidance: Information security responsibilities that remain valid after termination or change of employment shall be defined, enforced and communicated.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented responsibilities after termination or change of employment? (Annex A.6.5)

questions.guidance: Personnel and other interested parties shall return all organizational assets in their possession upon change or termination of employment, contract or agreement.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented return of assets? (Annex A.5.11)

questions.guidance: Physical security for offices, rooms and facilities shall be designed and implemented.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented securing offices, rooms and facilities? (Annex A.7.3)

questions.guidance: Off-site assets shall be protected.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented security of assets off-premises? (Annex A.7.9)

questions.guidance: Information processing facilities shall be protected from power failures and other disruptions caused by failures in supporting utilities.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented supporting utilities? (Annex A.7.11)

questions.guidance: Test information shall be appropriately selected, protected and managed.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented test information? (Annex A.8.33)

questions.guidance: Information relating to information security threats shall be collected and analysed to produce threat intelligence.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented threat intelligence? (Annex A.5.7)

questions.guidance: Access to external websites shall be managed to reduce exposure to malicious content.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented web filtering? (Annex A.8.23)

questions.guidance: Security measures for working in secure areas shall be designed and implemented.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented working in secure areas? (Annex A.7.6)

questions.guidance: Cables carrying power, data or supporting information services shall be protected from interception, interference or damage.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented cabling security? (Annex A.7.12)

questions.guidance: The clocks of information processing systems used by the organization shall be synchronized to approved time sources.
questions.text: Has your organization implemented clock synchronization? (Annex A.8.17)
